IACI groups six named conditions: long COVID, which follows SARS-CoV-2 infection and persists for at least three months; myalgic encephalomyelitis, or chronic fatigue syndrome, a condition decades older than COVID, marked by fatigue that rest doesn't fix; post-treatment Lyme disease syndrome, which follows antibiotic treatment for the bacterium that causes Lyme disease; post-Ebola syndrome; post-dengue fatigue syndrome; and the chronic fatigue and disability some SARS survivors experienced for years after the 2003 outbreak. These aren't the only post-infection syndromes that exist, but they're the ones with a similar enough pattern, and enough research attention, to study side by side.
